question.text: From the following statements, choose the incorrect statement regarding <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>.

options.text: It has to be kept away from dust.
It can act only as an oxidising agent.
It decomposes on exposure to light.
It has to be stored in plastic or wax-lined glass bottles in the dark.

solution.text: It can act both as an oxidizing agent and a reducing agent. The reason is the oxidation state of 'O' is -1.
